title.zh: 密码算法与密钥长度过渡
title.en: Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh.principle: **标准**：密码算法与密钥长度过渡（Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths）。这份文件的度量单位是`安全强度`：「In SP 800-57, the security strength provided by an algorithm with a particular key length … is measured in bits and is a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection that is provided by the algorithm and key.」并且强调「Note that the length of the cryptographic keys is an integral part of these determinations.」——算法与密钥长度必须一起判定。
zh.why: 过渡之所以要成文，是因为算法会随算力失效：文件为联邦政府设定当下下限——「For the Federal Government, a security strength of at least 112 bits is required at this time for applying cryptographic protection (e.g., for encrypting or signing data).」，并把未来变数写进定义——「When post-quantum cryptography is introduced in NIST standards, quantum security strength, i.e.the difficulty of subverting the protection using quantum computers, will be defined.」，术语注释把口径本身一并给出：「The term "security strength" refers to the classical security strength - a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection (e.g., discovering the key) using classical computers.」。
zh.used: 落地面是逐个算法清点：§2 从分组密码开始——「Encryption is a cryptographic operation that is used to provide confidentiality for sensitive information, and decryption is the inverse operation.」并列出联邦用过的算法族，如「The Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (TDEA) (often referred to as Triple DES) is specified in SP 800-67, and has two variations, known as two-key TDEA and three-key TDEA.」。
zh.broken: 限度一是身份：它是建议性指南而非 FIPS，权威声明写「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems」，并加一句「Nothing in this publication should be taken to contradict the standards and guidelines made mandatory and binding on federal agencies by the Secretary of Commerce under statutory authority.」，权威声明还说它是「may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States」的公开指南。限度二是时效：它把 128 位强度交给别处的时间表——「SP 800-57, Part 1 includes a transition to a security strength of 128 bits in 2030」，并自陈「However, this revision of SP 800-131A does not address this transition, but a future revision will include these considerations as well as transitions to post-quantum algorithms.」——128 位强度与后量子过渡都留给未来修订。
zh.history: 版本史可从自身与引用中读出：这是 Revision 2，标题行写「NIST Special Publication 800-131A Revision 2 Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths」；脚注 13 还把椭圆曲线批准口径挂到别处——「Until SP 800-186 is published, approved elliptic curves are specified in FIPS 186-4.」，把 TDEA 的弃用计划链接到 2017 年的 NIST 公告。该曲线指针只是 2019 年时的临时安排：本语料库内的 SP 800-186 标题日期为 2023 年 2 月，FIPS 186-5 亦于 2023 年 2 月 3 日取代 186-4，因此「approved elliptic curves are specified in FIPS 186-4」在今天已不成立。

en.principle: **Standard**: Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths (密码算法与密钥长度过渡). The unit of this publication is security strength: "In SP 800-57, the security strength provided by an algorithm with a particular key length … is measured in bits and is a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection that is provided by the algorithm and key." It stresses that "Note that the length of the cryptographic keys is an integral part of these determinations." — algorithm and key length are judged together.
en.why: Transitions need a written schedule because algorithms decay with computing power: the publication sets a floor for the federal government today — "For the Federal Government, a security strength of at least 112 bits is required at this time for applying cryptographic protection (e.g., for encrypting or signing data)." — and flags the future change in its own definitions, "When post-quantum cryptography is introduced in NIST standards, quantum security strength, i.e. the difficulty of subverting the protection using quantum computers, will be defined." while the note supplies the meaning itself, defining the measure as "a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection (e.g., discovering the key) using classical computers."
en.used: The work is an algorithm-by-algorithm inventory: §2 opens with block ciphers — "Encryption is a cryptographic operation that is used to provide confidentiality for sensitive information, and decryption is the inverse operation." — and lists the families used federally, for instance "The Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (TDEA) (often referred to as Triple DES) is specified in SP 800-67, and has two variations, known as two-key TDEA and three-key TDEA."
en.broken: The first limit is its standing: it is a recommendation, not a FIPS — the authority block says "such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems" and adds "Nothing in this publication should be taken to contradict the standards and guidelines made mandatory and binding on federal agencies by the Secretary of Commerce under statutory authority.", and the same block describes the publication as one that "may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States". The second is timing: the 128-bit move is booked elsewhere — "SP 800-57, Part 1 includes a transition to a security strength of 128 bits in 2030" — and the text concedes its own scope — "However, this revision of SP 800-131A does not address this transition, but a future revision will include these considerations as well as transitions to post-quantum algorithms."
en.history: Its history is legible from itself and its citations: this is Revision 2, titled "NIST Special Publication 800-131A Revision 2 Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths"; footnote 13 outsources curve approval — "Until SP 800-186 is published, approved elliptic curves are specified in FIPS 186-4." — and ties TDEA deprecation to a 2017 NIST announcement; that curve pointer was a 2019 placeholder only — SP 800-186 in this corpus is dated February 2023 and FIPS 186-5 superseded 186-4 on 3 February 2023, so the sentence no longer holds today.

zh: 安全强度：以比特衡量、破解保护难度的度量。
经典安全强度：不考虑量子算法的强度口径。
TDEA：三重数据加密算法，常称 Triple DES。
密钥长度：与安全强度共同决定的参数位数。
national security system：需另行批准才适用的系统类别。
en: Security strength: a bit measure of the difficulty of subverting protection.
Classical security strength: the strength measure ignoring quantum attacks.
TDEA: the Triple Data Encryption Algorithm, commonly Triple DES.
Key length: the bit size judged together with strength.
Deprecation: the announced phase-out of an algorithm.
National security system: the category needing separate approval.
